members.name: implied_vs_realized_vol_v1
members.universe: NIFTY 50 ETF (NIFTYBEES) or top-5 NIFTY stocks by weight on NSE
members.thesis: India VIX (implied vol) systematically overestimates realized NIFTY volatility by 3-5 vol points on average — the variance risk premium (VRP). When VIX spikes to >2 standard deviations above its 20-day mean but realized 5-day vol hasn't increased proportionally, the VRP is elevated and NIFTY tends t
entry_long: VRP_z > 2.0 (VRP is unusually high — implied vol overpricing fear)
VIX_z > 1.5 (VIX elevated relative to recent history)
VIX_rate_of_change > 5 (VIX spiked recently, likely to revert)
NIFTY_RSI_30 < 40 (market pulled back, creating entry opportunity)
entry_short: VRP_z < -1.5 (VRP collapsed — implied vol under-pricing risk)
members.exit_target: VRP_z returns to 0.5 (VRP normalizing) OR NIFTY gains 0.5% from entry
members.exit_stop: VRP_z exceeds 3.5 (VRP widening further — true risk event) OR NIFTY drops 0.5% from entry
filters: core of strategy — requires VIX > 15 for long signals (VRP meaningful only at elevated levels)
signal can trigger any time; prefer morning entry for full-session hold
NIFTY option volume must be > avg (confirming VIX is liquid/accurate)
NIFTY not in circuit-breaker territory or limit-down
weaknesses: Low signal frequency: VRP_z > 2.0 occurs only 5-10 times per month, making this a supplement strategy, not a standalone
The strategy is essentially long NIFTY on pullbacks with a VIX filter — during genuine bear markets, VIX spikes ARE justified and the strategy will lose on multiple consecutive signals
Intraday VRP calculation is noisy because India VIX can be stale (updated every few minutes, not truly real-time), causing false signals
members.prior_art: Carr & Wu (2009) variance risk premia; Bollerslev et al. (2009) expected stock returns and variance risk premia. Indian VRP studied by Sehgal & Vijayakumar (2008).

members.name: implied_vol_dislocation_v1
members.thesis: When India VIX (implied vol) diverges significantly from Nifty50 realized vol (last 20 days annualized), a correction is imminent. If VIX > 1.3 * realized_vol, the market is overpricing fear — go long equities. If VIX < 0.8 * realized_vol, the market is underpricing risk — go short. This inefficienc
filters: entry only 10:00-13:00 (need time for mean reversion to play out)
weaknesses: IV-RV dislocation can persist for days/weeks — intraday resolution is not guaranteed
Using a daily input (20-day RV) in a 1-min strategy creates a mismatch in signal granularity
Very low frequency — dislocation signals fire maybe 3-5 times per month
members.prior_art: Implied-realized volatility spread trade — standard options/vol arb concept. Applied here to equity direction.

members.name: vol_surface_signal_v1
members.universe: NIFTY 50 top-5 weighted stocks or NIFTYBEES on NSE
members.thesis: The NIFTY option volatility surface (IV across strikes and expiries) contains predictive information for intraday equity direction. Specifically, the put-call IV skew — the difference between OTM put IV and OTM call IV at the same delta — signals institutional hedging demand. When 25-delta put IV is
entry_long: NIFTY_RSI_30 < 40 (NIFTY has pulled back, confirming fear)
term_structure > 0 (contango — not a crisis term structure)
entry_short: skew_z < -1.5 (skew compressed — complacency, calls bid up)
members.exit_target: skew_z normalizes to 0.5 (long) or -0.5 (short); OR NIFTY moves 0.5% in trade direction
members.exit_stop: skew_z exceeds 3.5 (long) suggesting genuine crisis OR NIFTY drops 0.5% from entry
filters: India_VIX between 14 and 25 (need options to be liquid for accurate IV)
enter 09:30-13:00; skew signals need session time to play out
NIFTY option volume at 25-delta strikes > 1000 contracts (ensuring IV is reliable)
NIFTY not limit-down or in circuit-breaker mode
weaknesses: Requires real-time option chain data with accurate IV computation; Zerodha's API provides delayed option quotes which can make the skew signal stale
Extremely low frequency: skew_z > 2.0 signals fire only 2-4 times per month, making this a supplementary strategy only
When the skew is extreme for a genuine reason (geopolitical crisis, systemic risk), fading it produces large losses — the event filter cannot catch all such scenarios
members.prior_art: Bali & Hovakimian (2009) option implied volatility and equity returns; Xing et al. (2010) on skew and stock returns. Indian vol surface analysis by Jain & Jain (2019).
